description: This file contains unit tests for IPC (Inter-Process Communication) mechanisms within the WPEFramework project. It defines classes for responses and triplets, implements IPC server handlers, and includes multiple test cases for different IPC channel configurations such as continuous, flash, and multi-channel modes, both in normal and reversed roles.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Represents a response with a single uint32_t result, used in IPC responses.

classes.name: Triplet
classes.description: Represents a triplet with display, surface, and context identifiers, used as IPC parameters.

classes.name: HandleTripletResponse
classes.description: IPC server handler that processes TripletResponse messages and computes a result based on its parameters.

classes.name: HandleVoidTriplet
classes.description: IPC server handler that responds with a default Triplet object.

classes.name: HandleTextText
classes.description: IPC server handler that echoes back a text parameter.

methods.name: Procedure
methods.description: Implements the RPC procedure for each handler, processing incoming IPC messages.
